Saved to `/brief.md`. Here is the brief:

Small accounting firms hold some of the most sensitive client data there is — tax records, payroll details, and banking information — so a backup that fails silently can turn a minor glitch into a regulatory and reputational crisis. An untested backup is only a hope: drives fill up, credentials expire, and ransomware increasingly targets backup copies first, meaning the firm often discovers the problem at the worst possible moment. A short quarterly restore drill, ideally recovering a single client file and a full system image, proves the process actually works, documents how long it takes, and gives partners the confidence to tell clients and insurers that their data is genuinely protected.
